frozen_candidate_root_contribution: ع م ل denotes agentive, effort-bearing enactment or production attributable to a doer: the carried-out act, the sustained practice, or the fashioned output that issues from an agent's exercised capacity and is thereafter imputed back to that agent. The finite verb (Form I only), the maSdar/plural عمل~أعمال (the act/product as a storable, weighable record), and the participle عامل (the agent) are one nucleus. The root is morally neutral in itself; righteous or evil valence is supplied only by an added qualifier, object, or the recompense frame, never by the root.

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: ع م ل denotes agentive, effort-bearing enactment or production attributable to a doer: the carried-out act, the sustained practice, or the fashioned output that issues from an agent's exercised capacity and is thereafter imputed back to that agent. The finite verb (Form I only), the maSdar/plural عمل~أعمال (the act/product as a storable, weighable record), and the participle عامل (the agent) are one nucleus. The root is morally neutral in itself; righteous or evil valence is supplied only by an added qualifier, object, or the recompense frame, never by the root.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: ع م ل is 'to do/make/work' in the sense of an agent actually carrying something out, so that the result is credited to that agent. What is done ranges from a physical artifact (armor, statues, cattle) to bare toil to moral conduct. The noun names the deed or product as a record that can be paid, weighed, or nullified; the participle names the worker. Goodness or evil is added by context, not carried by the root itself. The overwhelmingly common 'righteous deeds / God sees what you do / deeds made vain' usage is a dominant deployment of this neutral core, not the core's own meaning.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Does NOT entail: (1) moral goodness — valence needs a qualifier: عمل غير صالح (11:46), عمل سيئة (40:40:2:1), تعمل الخبائث (21:74), خلطوا عملا صالحا وآخر سيئا (9:102); (2) inner faith — عمل is systematically conjoined-yet-distinct from آمن (آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات, 103:3); (3) speech/word — ranked against الكلم الطيب in 35:10; (4) creation ex nihilo — kept distinct from خلق in the apposition of 36:71; (5) achieved efficacy — real عمل can come to nothing: ashes 14:18, mirage 24:39, حبطت 18:105; (6) invariant human agency or invariant toil-cost — God is agent in 36:71 with no toil or accountability, jinn/devils act in 21:82/34:13, angels in 21:27; (7) mere intention or capacity — it is the carried-out act, not the willing behind it.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 36:71:7:1 مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَٰمًا — God's hands 'made' cattle. It defeats the salient moral-deed reading on three axes: the agent is God (no accountability/recompense), the product is a living creature (not a deed), and عمل stands in apposition to خَلَقْنَا; this forces the neutral, productive width of the nucleus and shows the moral-conduct sense is a contextual specialization, not the root floor.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: That the root's meaning simply IS 'the morally-accountable deed subject to divine recompense.' It is the most Quranically salient reading, fitting ~85-90% of tokens (the بما تعملون witness-formula, the جزاء/أجر frame, the حبطت أعمالهم nullification field, the آمنوا+عملوا pairing). It is rejected as the lexical meaning because it over-reaches past a coherent, non-lexicalized resistant sub-class that stands outside moral reckoning — physical fabrication (34:11 armor, 34:13 statues/basins, 36:71 cattle, 36:35 handiwork), occupational labour (9:60 zakat functionaries, 18:79 sea-workers), and bare toil (88:3) — and because manufacture and moral-doing share one verb in a single breath (34:11), proving the moral coloring is contextual, not root-borne.

It is rejected as the lexical meaning because it over-reaches past a coherent, non-lexicalized resistant sub-class that stands outside moral reckoning — physical fabrication (34:11 armor, 34:13 statues/basins, 36:71 cattle, 36:35 handiwork), occupational labour (9:60 zakat functionaries, 18:79 sea-workers), and bare toil (88:3) — and because manufacture and moral-doing share one verb in a single breath (34:11), proving the moral coloring is contextual, not root-borne.
internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses converge that a single nucleus is real and is bridged Quran-internally, so UNRESOLVED/multi-class would be dishonest: 34:11 commands 'make coats of mail' (اعمل سابغات) and 'do righteousness' (اعملوا صالحا) with the same imperative in one verse, and cognate co-occurrence welds the derivatives (37:61 verb+participle, 3:195 maSdar+participle, 23:63 noun+participle, 21:82 verb+its own maSdar). But STRONG/UNIVERSAL over-grades: the distinctive, useful account (agent-imputable conduct that is morally qualifiable and stored for recompense) is capped below STRONG by a coherent resistant sub-class of concrete labour/fabrication (34:11, 34:13, 36:71, 36:35, 18:79), the God-as-agent case (36:71) showing the moral sense is not the floor, one semi-lexicalized occupational item (9:60), and the materially resistant 11:46 where عمل is predicated of a person. The only account with NO resistant sub-class — the thin 'agentive productive enactment' nucleus — verges on the vague-abstraction failure the contract warns against. Either horn caps at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE per the contract's explicit rule. Additionally, from the Eml packet alone the root's distinctive 'answerability' profile cannot be proven lexically exclusive versus فعل/صنع/كسب (11:16 pairs صنعوا with يعملون; 30:41 pairs كسبت with عملوا), so distinctiveness is CONSISTENT-and-frame-driven, not established. Grade: PREFERRED nucleus, MODERATE strength, REPRESENTATIVE scope over the derivational family.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Finite Form-I verb عمل/يعمل/اعمل = to carry out / perform / make. Morally neutral agentive enactment: governs righteous objects (34:11:7:2 اعملوا صالحا; 40:40:9:1 عمل صالحا) and evil ones (40:40:2:1 عمل سيئة; 21:74:10:1 تعمل الخبائث), the bare accountability frame (بما تعملون + عليم/بصير/خبير), the defiance formula (اعملوا على مكانتكم اني عامل), undirected agency (17:84 كل يعمل على شاكلته), and concrete fabrication/labour (34:11:2:1 اعمل سابغات; 34:13 fashion objects; 36:71/36:35 hands make; 18:79 work at sea; 21:82 do work).
clusters.classification_rationale: All 276 verbs are surface Form I (qac_verb_form null; one-stem verb). They are grouped by shared part-of-speech because the split between moral-conduct and concrete-labour deployments is internal to this same verb and is bridged inside single verses (34:11), so it is a contextual range of one lexical item, not a second cluster.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Dominant deployment is the omniscience/recompense frame (بما تعملون بصير/خبير/عليم at 2:110, 24:53, 22:68; لتسألن عما كنتم تعملون 16:93; هل تجزون الا ما كنتم تعملون 27:90); the verb takes both moral polarities, confirming neutrality of the stem itself.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Deverbal noun عمل / plural أعمال = the act or product as a storable, weighable, answerable record (14:18/24:39 likened to ashes/mirage; 18:105 حبطت أعمالهم ... فلا نقيم لهم وزنا; 11:111 يوفينهم أعمالهم); and the active participle عامل/عاملون/عاملين = the doer/worker to whom the act is imputed (3:195 عمل عامل منكم; 37:61 فليعمل العاملون; 23:63 هم لها عاملون). Includes the neutral maSdar (9:102 عملا صالحا وآخر سيئا; 10:41 عملي/عملكم; 21:82:7:1 عملا; 35:10 العمل الصالح ranked against speech).
clusters.classification_rationale: The maSdar-record and the nomen-agentis are the noun-side derivatives of the one verbal nucleus, cross-bridged to the verb by cognate co-occurrence (3:195, 23:63, 37:61). Grouped by part-of-speech; the internal record-vs-agent distinction is derivational, not a separate root sense.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Plural أعمال is the thing nullified/paid/shown (2:217, 5:53, 7:147, 9:69, 47:1, 99:6, 11:111); singular عمل is qualified for better/worse (11:7, 18:7, 67:2 أحسن عملا) — the noun names the deed as record, valence added by qualifier.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Sole adjectival participle عاملة (88:3 عاملة ناصبة, of faces) = 'toiling, labouring', glossed by its pairing with نصب (fatigue). Denotes sheer effortful exertion with no object and no moral-reckoning content — the effort/toil feature of the nucleus surfaced in isolation.
clusters.classification_rationale: The single ADJ token is separated only by its part-of-speech tag; semantically it instantiates the effort component already in the nucleus (cf. labour uses 9:60, 18:79), so it is consistent, not a distinct sense.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 88:3 pairs عاملة with ناصبة (weary), fixing the reading on physical toil rather than moral deed — direct evidence that the root's floor is effortful doing, not virtue.

reconciliation.rationale: The noun morphology EamalN blocks the dissolving verb-reading, and predicating عمل of a person (not an act) is a genuine material strain; honesty requires marking it RESISTANT rather than smoothing it, and it is the single token that caps the account below full comprehensiveness.

It instantiates the neutral nucleus 'workers on X' (agentive labour attributed to a doer); it is singular and transparent, so it is a semi-lexicalized deployment, not a resistant class, and does not by itself open a second root-meaning.

adversarial_verification.notes: The neutral-agentive-enactment core survives the strongest sought counterexamples (36:71 God-as-agent, 34:11 armor/righteousness in one verb, 34:13 fabrication), which calibrate rather than break it, so the core is not refuted. But it is NOT_RUN as a passing falsification because (a) 11:46 materially resists (person predicated as عمل), and (b) distinctiveness_ok is false: from the Eml packet alone the root's answerability profile cannot be proven lexically exclusive versus فعل/صنع/كسب (11:16 صنعوا//يعملون; 30:41 كسبت//عملوا). A clean SUPPORTED with empty failing_occurrences was therefore not obtained.

occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Deverbal noun عمل / plural أعمال = the act or product as a storable, weighable, answerable record (14:18/24:39 likened to ashes/mirage; 18:105 حبطت أعمالهم ... فلا نقيم لهم وزنا; 11:111 يوفينهم أعمالهم); and the active participle عامل/عاملون/عاملين = the doer/worker to whom the act is imputed (3:195 عمل عامل منكم; 37:61 فليعمل العاملون; 23:63 هم لها عاملون). Includes the neutral maSdar (9:102 عملا صالحا وآخر سيئا; 10:41 عملي/عملكم; 21:82:7:1 عملا; 35:10 العمل الصالح ranked against speech).
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: Plural أعمال is the thing nullified/paid/shown (2:217, 5:53, 7:147, 9:69, 47:1, 99:6, 11:111); singular عمل is qualified for better/worse (11:7, 18:7, 67:2 أحسن عملا) — the noun names the deed as record, valence added by qualifier.

occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Deverbal noun عمل / plural أعمال = the act or product as a storable, weighable, answerable record (14:18/24:39 likened to ashes/mirage; 18:105 حبطت أعمالهم ... فلا نقيم لهم وزنا; 11:111 يوفينهم أعمالهم); and the active participle عامل/عاملون/عاملين = the doer/worker to whom the act is imputed (3:195 عمل عامل منكم; 37:61 فليعمل العاملون; 23:63 هم لها عاملون). Includes the neutral maSdar (9:102 عملا صالحا وآخر سيئا; 10:41 عملي/عملكم; 21:82:7:1 عملا; 35:10 العمل الصالح ranked against speech).
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: Plural أعمال is the thing nullified/paid/shown (2:217, 5:53, 7:147, 9:69, 47:1, 99:6, 11:111); singular عمل is qualified for better/worse (11:7, 18:7, 67:2 أحسن عملا) — the noun names the deed as record, valence added by qualifier.

Grouped by part-of-speech; the internal record-vs-agent distinction is derivational, not a separate root sense.
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Deverbal noun عمل / plural أعمال = the act or product as a storable, weighable, answerable record (14:18/24:39 likened to ashes/mirage; 18:105 حبطت أعمالهم ... فلا نقيم لهم وزنا; 11:111 يوفينهم أعمالهم); and the active participle عامل/عاملون/عاملين = the doer/worker to whom the act is imputed (3:195 عمل عامل منكم; 37:61 فليعمل العاملون; 23:63 هم لها عاملون). Includes the neutral maSdar (9:102 عملا صالحا وآخر سيئا; 10:41 عملي/عملكم; 21:82:7:1 عملا; 35:10 العمل الصالح ranked against speech).
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: Plural أعمال is the thing nullified/paid/shown (2:217, 5:53, 7:147, 9:69, 47:1, 99:6, 11:111); singular عمل is qualified for better/worse (11:7, 18:7, 67:2 أحسن عملا) — the noun names the deed as record, valence added by qualifier.
occurrence_dispositions.preliminary_note: The maSdar-record and the nomen-agentis are the noun-side derivatives of the one verbal nucleus, cross-bridged to the verb by cognate co-occurrence (3:195, 23:63, 37:61). Grouped by part-of-speech; the internal record-vs-agent distinction is derivational, not a separate root sense.

occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: Dominant deployment is the omniscience/recompense frame (بما تعملون بصير/خبير/عليم at 2:110, 24:53, 22:68; لتسألن عما كنتم تعملون 16:93; هل تجزون الا ما كنتم تعملون 27:90); the verb takes both moral polarities, confirming neutrality of the stem itself.

occurrence_dispositions.note: The maSdar-record and the nomen-agentis are the noun-side derivatives of the one verbal nucleus, cross-bridged to the verb by cognate co-occurrence (3:195, 23:63, 37:61). occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Deverbal noun عمل / plural أعمال = the act or product as a storable, weighable, answerable record (14:18/24:39 likened to ashes/mirage; 18:105 حبطت أعمالهم ... فلا نقيم لهم وزنا; 11:111 يوفينهم أعمالهم); and the active participle عامل/عاملون/عاملين = the doer/worker to whom the act is imputed (3:195 عمل عامل منكم; 37:61 فليعمل العاملون; 23:63 هم لها عاملون). Includes the neutral maSdar (9:102 عملا صالحا وآخر سيئا; 10:41 عملي/عملكم; 21:82:7:1 عملا; 35:10 العمل الصالح ranked against speech).
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: Plural أعمال is the thing nullified/paid/shown (2:217, 5:53, 7:147, 9:69, 47:1, 99:6, 11:111); singular عمل is qualified for better/worse (11:7, 18:7, 67:2 أحسن عملا) — the noun names the deed as record, valence added by qualifier.

occurrence_dispositions.note: The maSdar-record and the nomen-agentis are the noun-side derivatives of the one verbal nucleus, cross-bridged to the verb by cognate co-occurrence (3:195, 23:63, 37:61). Grouped by part-of-speech; the internal record-vs-agent distinction is derivational, not a separate root sense.
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Deverbal noun عمل / plural أعمال = the act or product as a storable, weighable, answerable record (14:18/24:39 likened to ashes/mirage; 18:105 حبطت أعمالهم ... فلا نقيم لهم وزنا; 11:111 يوفينهم أعمالهم); and the active participle عامل/عاملون/عاملين = the doer/worker to whom the act is imputed (3:195 عمل عامل منكم; 37:61 فليعمل العاملون; 23:63 هم لها عاملون). Includes the neutral maSdar (9:102 عملا صالحا وآخر سيئا; 10:41 عملي/عملكم; 21:82:7:1 عملا; 35:10 العمل الصالح ranked against speech).
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: Plural أعمال is the thing nullified/paid/shown (2:217, 5:53, 7:147, 9:69, 47:1, 99:6, 11:111); singular عمل is qualified for better/worse (11:7, 18:7, 67:2 أحسن عملا) — the noun names the deed as record, valence added by qualifier.

occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Deverbal noun عمل / plural أعمال = the act or product as a storable, weighable, answerable record (14:18/24:39 likened to ashes/mirage; 18:105 حبطت أعمالهم ... فلا نقيم لهم وزنا; 11:111 يوفينهم أعمالهم); and the active participle عامل/عاملون/عاملين = the doer/worker to whom the act is imputed (3:195 عمل عامل منكم; 37:61 فليعمل العاملون; 23:63 هم لها عاملون). Includes the neutral maSdar (9:102 عملا صالحا وآخر سيئا; 10:41 عملي/عملكم; 21:82:7:1 عملا; 35:10 العمل الصالح ranked against speech).
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: Plural أعمال is the thing nullified/paid/shown (2:217, 5:53, 7:147, 9:69, 47:1, 99:6, 11:111); singular عمل is qualified for better/worse (11:7, 18:7, 67:2 أحسن عملا) — the noun names the deed as record, valence added by qualifier.

occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Deverbal noun عمل / plural أعمال = the act or product as a storable, weighable, answerable record (14:18/24:39 likened to ashes/mirage; 18:105 حبطت أعمالهم ... فلا نقيم لهم وزنا; 11:111 يوفينهم أعمالهم); and the active participle عامل/عاملون/عاملين = the doer/worker to whom the act is imputed (3:195 عمل عامل منكم; 37:61 فليعمل العاملون; 23:63 هم لها عاملون). Includes the neutral maSdar (9:102 عملا صالحا وآخر سيئا; 10:41 عملي/عملكم; 21:82:7:1 عملا; 35:10 العمل الصالح ranked against speech).
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: Plural أعمال is the thing nullified/paid/shown (2:217, 5:53, 7:147, 9:69, 47:1, 99:6, 11:111); singular عمل is qualified for better/worse (11:7, 18:7, 67:2 أحسن عملا) — the noun names the deed as record, valence added by qualifier.

occurrence_dispositions.preliminary_note: The single ADJ token is separated only by its part-of-speech tag; semantically it instantiates the effort component already in the nucleus (cf. labour uses 9:60, 18:79), so it is consistent, not a distinct sense.

occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Deverbal noun عمل / plural أعمال = the act or product as a storable, weighable, answerable record (14:18/24:39 likened to ashes/mirage; 18:105 حبطت أعمالهم ... فلا نقيم لهم وزنا; 11:111 يوفينهم أعمالهم); and the active participle عامل/عاملون/عاملين = the doer/worker to whom the act is imputed (3:195 عمل عامل منكم; 37:61 فليعمل العاملون; 23:63 هم لها عاملون). Includes the neutral maSdar (9:102 عملا صالحا وآخر سيئا; 10:41 عملي/عملكم; 21:82:7:1 عملا; 35:10 العمل الصالح ranked against speech).
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: Plural أعمال is the thing nullified/paid/shown (2:217, 5:53, 7:147, 9:69, 47:1, 99:6, 11:111); singular عمل is qualified for better/worse (11:7, 18:7, 67:2 أحسن عملا) — the noun names the deed as record, valence added by qualifier.

occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Deverbal noun عمل / plural أعمال = the act or product as a storable, weighable, answerable record (14:18/24:39 likened to ashes/mirage; 18:105 حبطت أعمالهم ... فلا نقيم لهم وزنا; 11:111 يوفينهم أعمالهم); and the active participle عامل/عاملون/عاملين = the doer/worker to whom the act is imputed (3:195 عمل عامل منكم; 37:61 فليعمل العاملون; 23:63 هم لها عاملون). Includes the neutral maSdar (9:102 عملا صالحا وآخر سيئا; 10:41 عملي/عملكم; 21:82:7:1 عملا; 35:10 العمل الصالح ranked against speech).
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: Plural أعمال is the thing nullified/paid/shown (2:217, 5:53, 7:147, 9:69, 47:1, 99:6, 11:111); singular عمل is qualified for better/worse (11:7, 18:7, 67:2 أحسن عملا) — the noun names the deed as record, valence added by qualifier.

occurrence_dispositions.note: All 276 verbs are surface Form I (qac_verb_form null; one-stem verb). They are grouped by shared part-of-speech because the split between moral-conduct and concrete-labour deployments is internal to this same verb and is bridged inside single verses (34:11), so it is a contextual range of one lexical item, not a second cluster.
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Finite Form-I verb عمل/يعمل/اعمل = to carry out / perform / make. Morally neutral agentive enactment: governs righteous objects (34:11:7:2 اعملوا صالحا; 40:40:9:1 عمل صالحا) and evil ones (40:40:2:1 عمل سيئة; 21:74:10:1 تعمل الخبائث), the bare accountability frame (بما تعملون + عليم/بصير/خبير), the defiance formula (اعملوا على مكانتكم اني عامل), undirected agency (17:84 كل يعمل على شاكلته), and concrete fabrication/labour (34:11:2:1 اعمل سابغات; 34:13 fashion objects; 36:71/36:35 hands make; 18:79 work at sea; 21:82 do work).
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: Dominant deployment is the omniscience/recompense frame (بما تعملون بصير/خبير/عليم at 2:110, 24:53, 22:68; لتسألن عما كنتم تعملون 16:93; هل تجزون الا ما كنتم تعملون 27:90); the verb takes both moral polarities, confirming neutrality of the stem itself.

occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Finite Form-I verb عمل/يعمل/اعمل = to carry out / perform / make. Morally neutral agentive enactment: governs righteous objects (34:11:7:2 اعملوا صالحا; 40:40:9:1 عمل صالحا) and evil ones (40:40:2:1 عمل سيئة; 21:74:10:1 تعمل الخبائث), the bare accountability frame (بما تعملون + عليم/بصير/خبير), the defiance formula (اعملوا على مكانتكم اني عامل), undirected agency (17:84 كل يعمل على شاكلته), and concrete fabrication/labour (34:11:2:1 اعمل سابغات; 34:13 fashion objects; 36:71/36:35 hands make; 18:79 work at sea; 21:82 do work).
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: Dominant deployment is the omniscience/recompense frame (بما تعملون بصير/خبير/عليم at 2:110, 24:53, 22:68; لتسألن عما كنتم تعملون 16:93; هل تجزون الا ما كنتم تعملون 27:90); the verb takes both moral polarities, confirming neutrality of the stem itself.

resistant_deep_analysis.preliminary_note: Read as metonymy: Noah's son is [the embodiment of] an unrighteous course of conduct, keeping it inside the nucleus.
resistant_deep_analysis.reconciliation_rationale: The noun morphology EamalN blocks the dissolving verb-reading, and predicating عمل of a person (not an act) is a genuine material strain; honesty requires marking it RESISTANT rather than smoothing it, and it is the single token that caps the account below full comprehensiveness.

independent_verification: Three independent lenses (A, B, C) each opened the full 360-occurrence packet; A and C independently graded MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE and B graded STRONG/COMPREHENSIVE, with the divergence resolved against B because the manufacture/labour uses (34:11, 34:13, 36:71, 9:60, 18:79) form a coherent resistant sub-class to the distinctive moral-deed account and 11:46 materially resists.
candidate_root_contribution: ع م ل denotes agentive, effort-bearing enactment or production attributable to a doer: the carried-out act, the sustained practice, or the fashioned output that issues from an agent's exercised capacity and is thereafter imputed back to that agent. The finite verb (Form I only), the maSdar/plural عمل~أعمال (the act/product as a storable, weighable record), and the participle عامل (the agent) are one nucleus. The root is morally neutral in itself; righteous or evil valence is supplied only by an added qualifier, object, or the recompense frame, never by the root.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 360 occurrences (V 276, N 83, ADJ 1); qac_verb_form null throughout (surface Form I, one-stem verb). The verb takes both righteous (34:11:7:2, 40:40:9:1) and evil (40:40:2:1, 21:74:10:1) objects; the noun أعمال is a weighable record (14:18, 18:105, 11:111); عمل reaches concrete fabrication (34:11 armor, 34:13 objects, 36:71 cattle, 36:35 handiwork) and bare toil (88:3, 9:60, 18:79).
layer_attribution.derivation: One nucleus realized as a transparent triad — finite verb, maSdar/plural عمل~أعمال (act/product-as-record), and participle عامل (agent) — welded by cognate intra-verse co-occurrence: 37:61 (verb+participle), 3:195 (maSdar+participle), 23:63 (noun+participle), 21:82 (verb+cognate maSdar).
layer_attribution.lexical_class: 9:60 العاملين عليها is a semi-lexicalized occupational role (zakat functionaries), and 88:3 عاملة is a sole ADJ participle of toil; both instantiate the neutral nucleus rather than forming a distinct lexicalized meaning, so they cap comprehensiveness but do not fracture the root.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: The dominant recompense/omniscience deployment (بما تعملون + بصير/خبير/عليم; جزاء/أجر; حبطت أعمالهم) and the moral-qualifier formulas (عملوا الصالحات, عمل سيئة) are contextual/narrative overlays; they must NOT be read as the root claim — righteousness/evil and answerability are supplied by co-text and frame, not by ع م ل itself.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: 11:46 was down-graded from a metonymic CONSISTENT reading to RESISTANT because the noun morphology blocks the verb-reading and a person is not an act-token; 9:60 was up-graded from apparent lexical resistance to CONSISTENT as a transparent 'workers on X' deployment. The competitor moral-deed account was recorded as dominant-but-not-lexical.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: One materially resistant token remains: 11:46:8:1 (عمل predicated of a human being), retained as a RESISTANT_SEAM hard case. It is a single occurrence, not a class, so it caps strength at MODERATE without forcing UNRESOLVED. Distinctiveness versus فعل/صنع/كسب is unestablished from this packet.

hard_cases.reason: عمل predicated of a human being (Noah's son); a person is not an enactment/output, so the nucleus holds only via rhetorical metonymy.

evidence_basis.statement: 11:46:8:1 إِنَّهُۥ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَٰلِحٍ — the noun عمل is predicated of a human being; a person is not an enactment/output, so this materially strains the nucleus and survives only as rhetorical metonymy, not as a plain act-token.

hard_cases.reason: God as agent producing a physical creature in apposition to خلقنا defeats the moral-deed reading and fixes the neutral productive floor.

evidence_basis.statement: 36:71:7:1 مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَٰمًا — God's hands 'made' cattle. It defeats the salient moral-deed reading on three axes: the agent is God (no accountability/recompense), the product is a living creature (not a deed), and عمل stands in apposition to خَلَقْنَا; this forces the neutral, productive width of the nucleus and shows the moral-conduct sense is a contextual specialization, not the root floor.

hard_cases.reason: Same imperative for making armor and doing righteousness in one verse — the decisive Quran-internal bridge across the manufacture/moral poles.

evidence_basis.statement: 34:11:2:1 اعْمَلْ سَٰبِغَٰتٍ alongside 34:11:7:2 اعْمَلُوا۟ صَٰلِحًا — the same imperative commands fashioning coats of mail and doing righteousness in one breath; the Quran-internal bridge proving manufacture and moral-doing are one verb, not two roots.

hard_cases.reason: Concrete fabrication of objects by jinn, outside any moral-reckoning frame, part of the resistant labour sub-class.

evidence_basis.statement: 34:13:1:1 يَعْمَلُونَ لَهُۥ ... مِن مَّحَٰرِيبَ وَتَمَٰثِيلَ وَجِفَانٍ — the jinn fabricate sanctuaries, statues and basins; concrete fabrication belonging to the neutral productive nucleus, outside any moral-reckoning frame.

hard_cases.reason: Semi-lexicalized occupational role (zakat functionaries), the one near-technical employment sense.

evidence_basis.statement: 9:60:5:3 وَٱلْعَٰمِلِينَ عَلَيْهَا — semi-lexicalized occupational role: the zakat functionaries/employees paid from the fund, a near-technical 'those employed on it', which resists a purely moral-deed reading yet fully instantiates the neutral nucleus 'workers on X'.

hard_cases.reason: Sole ADJ token; adjectival participle of faces = toiling/weary, the effort feature in isolation.

evidence_basis.statement: 88:3:1:1 عَامِلَةٌ نَّاصِبَةٌ — the sole ADJ, participle used adjectivally of faces = 'toiling, weary'; stretches from 'worker' to 'expending toil', which is exactly the effort feature already in the nucleus.

hard_case_representation.rationale: One nucleus is bridged Quran-internally (34:11, 37:61, 3:195, 23:63), so the result is not unresolved; but genuine evidentiary edges exist: one materially resistant token (11:46), an adversarial concrete-fabrication/God-as-agent boundary (36:71, 34:11, 34:13) that calibrates the nucleus to neutral productive width, and structural atypicalities (9:60 semi-lexicalized, 88:3 sole ADJ). Each hard case is grounded in a specific packet occurrence and its predication/agent/product evidence.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quran-internal occurrence in which عمل carries a valence, outcome, or reckoning intrinsically — e.g. عمل used approvingly with no qualifier and incapable of taking an evil object/qualifier anywhere in the corpus, or عمل denoting an involuntary event with no attributable agent — would refute the claim that the root is neutral agentive enactment whose moral coloring is contextual.
rejection_condition.search_location: The بما تعملون accountability frame, the أعمال nullification field (2:217, 18:105, 47:1), the qualifier-bearing tokens (34:11:7:2 صالحا vs 40:40:2:1 سيئة vs 21:74 الخبائث vs 9:102 خلطوا عملا صالحا وآخر سيئا), and the agent-diverse cases (36:71 God, 21:82/34:13 jinn, 21:27 angels).
rejection_condition.verification_method: Enumerate every object/qualifier the verb and noun take and every grammatical agent, testing whether any occurrence forces valence or outcome without an added modifier, and whether any agentless/involuntary use exists.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Distinguish root contribution from the recompense-frame deployment and from co-text qualifiers (صالح/سيئ/الخبائث); do not let the ~85-90% moral-frame statistical dominance be read as lexical meaning, and do not import فعل/صنع/كسب contrasts as if the packet proved exclusivity.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If عمل is shown to carry intrinsic valence/outcome or to license agentless involuntary events, the neutral-agentive-enactment nucleus is falsified and the root would be reclassified toward the moral-deed sense (raising strength of the competitor) or split, and this PREFERRED/MODERATE judgment must be downgraded or reopened.

reopen_conditions: If a cross-packet comparison of عمل against صنع (11:16), فعل (39:70), and كسب (14:18, 30:41) becomes available and demonstrates a distinctive answerability/attribution feature exclusive to ع م ل, reconsider raising to STRONG.

If 11:46 (عمل غير صالح of Noah's son) is re-analyzed and its person-as-deed predication is resolved as a non-metonymic act-token, reconsider whether the account can be graded COMPREHENSIVE with no residual resistance.

If the concrete-labour/fabrication sub-class (34:11 armor, 34:13 statues, 36:71 cattle, 9:60 zakat-workers, 18:79 sea-workers) is shown to be a separable lexicalized class rather than an internal deployment of the verb, reconsider splitting toward UNRESOLVED_CLASS_ONLY.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: The neutral-agentive-enactment core survives the strongest sought counterexamples (36:71 God-as-agent, 34:11 armor/righteousness in one verb, 34:13 fabrication), which calibrate rather than break it, so the core is not refuted. But it is NOT_RUN as a passing falsification because (a) 11:46 materially resists (person predicated as عمل), and (b) distinctiveness_ok is false: from the Eml packet alone the root's answerability profile cannot be proven lexically exclusive versus فعل/صنع/كسب (11:16 صنعوا//يعملون; 30:41 كسبت//عملوا). A clean SUPPORTED with empty failing_occurrences was therefore not obtained.
